Direct Hits against <solar/>Scorched Enemies apply additional <solar/>Scorch on a 0.5 second cooldown: 
• <primary/>Primary Weapons apply <pve 10 /> <pvp [4] /> additional <solar/>Scorch per Direct Hit (<pve 15 /> <pvp [9?] /> with <solar/>Ember of Ashes)
• <special/>Special and <heavy/>Power Weapons apply 20 additional <solar/>Scorch (30 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes)

Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to <solar/>Scorch the target. Hit counter persists through stow.

Number of Direct Hits required by weapon type:
• Bows: #e${2#c}
• Swords: #e${3#c}
• Other Weapons: 55% of the base magazine size #e #c

<solar/>Scorch applied by Burning Ambition to Unscorched targets counts as Weapon Damage.

<solar/>Ember of Ashes increases the amount of <solar/>Scorch applied by 50%.

#e Decreases the number of Direct Hits required by one.
